items.name: Budget Justification Generator
items.description: Uploads a grant budget form, the project narrative / proposal, and optionally the funding opportunity announcement (NOFO / RFA), and returns a single structured JSON object capturing both the structured per-section extracted financial data AND the generated narrative text for each section, plus the final assembled Markdown document and cross-validation notes. Output conforms to the budget-justification-generator-udm component schema. The runtime mirrors the ui-insight/ProcessMapping budget-justification-generator workflow's four parallel Extraction tasks (each extracting data and generating narrative) plus a Consolidation Prompt that assembles everything in R&R Budget / SF-424A category order.

steps.name: Parallel Budget Category Extraction and Justification Generation

data.name: extract-personnel-and-fringe
data.prompt:
You are extracting personnel data AND generating the
professional justification narrative for Sections A
(Senior/Key Personnel), B (Other Personnel), and C (Fringe
Benefits) of an R&R Budget / SF-424A. Mirrors TASK-1-1 of the
source ProcessMapping budget-justification-generator workflow.

Be 100% accurate. Reproduce financial figures verbatim from
the budget form. Tie each person's effort and salary to roles
and responsibilities described in the project narrative.
Generate professional third-person narrative text.

Monetary fields are JSON NUMBERS, not quoted strings. Convert
"$125,400.00" -> 125400.

For each searchset item return the document's evidence and / or
generated narrative:

- senior_key_personnel: JSON array of
  {name, title, role, person_months, salary_basis,
   requested_salary} objects. MUST be non-empty.
- other_personnel: JSON array of
  {category, count, person_months, rate} objects. Empty array
  when no other personnel are listed.
- total_senior_personnel_cost: JSON number.
- total_other_personnel_cost: JSON number or null.
- fringe_benefit_rates: JSON array of
  {category, rate, calculation_basis} objects.
- total_fringe_benefits: JSON number.
- is_salary_cap_applicable: JSON boolean or null.
- salary_cap_amount: JSON number or null.
- year_over_year_personnel_changes: string or null.
- section_a_narrative: generated professional narrative for
  Section A.
- section_b_narrative: generated narrative for Section B (use
  "No other personnel costs are requested for this project."
  when other_personnel is empty).
- section_c_narrative: generated narrative for Section C
  (fringe benefits).

data.name: extract-equipment-and-travel
data.prompt:
You are extracting equipment and travel data AND generating the
professional justification narrative for Sections D (Equipment)
and E (Travel: Domestic + Foreign). Mirrors TASK-1-2 of the
source workflow.

Monetary fields are JSON NUMBERS.

For each searchset item return data and / or narrative:
- equipment_items: JSON array of {name, cost, purpose} objects.
  Empty array when no equipment requested.
- total_equipment_cost: JSON number.
- equipment_threshold_applied: string or null.
- domestic_travel: JSON array of
  {destination, purpose, travelers, duration_days, total_cost}.
- foreign_travel: JSON array of same shape.
- total_domestic_travel_cost, total_foreign_travel_cost: JSON
  numbers.
- is_foreign_travel_restricted: JSON boolean or null.
- travel_cost_basis: string or null.
- section_d_narrative: generated narrative for Section D.
  Use "No equipment costs are requested for this project."
  when equipment_items is empty.
- section_e_domestic_narrative: generated narrative for
  domestic travel.
- section_e_foreign_narrative: generated narrative for foreign
  travel.

You are extracting participant support and Other Direct Costs
data AND generating the professional justification narrative
for Sections F (Participant/Trainee Support) and G (Other
Direct Costs with nine subcategories G.1-G.9). Mirrors
TASK-1-3 of the source workflow.

Monetary fields are JSON NUMBERS.

For each searchset item return data and / or narrative:
- participant_support_costs: JSON array of {category, cost}
  objects. Empty when none.
- total_participant_support: JSON number.
- materials_and_supplies: JSON array of {category, cost}
  objects. Empty when none.
- publication_costs: JSON number or null.
- consultant_services: JSON array of
  {name, rate, days, total, scope} objects. Empty when none.
- adp_computing_services: string or null.
- subaward_details: JSON array of
  {institution, pi, scope, total_cost} objects. Empty when
  none.
- total_subaward_costs: JSON number or null.
- equipment_rental, alterations_and_renovations: strings or
  null.
- tuition_remission: JSON number or null.
- other_direct_costs: JSON array of {category, cost} objects.
  Empty when none.
- total_other_direct_costs: JSON number (sum across all G
  subcategories).
- section_f_narrative: generated narrative for Section F.
- section_g_narrative: generated narrative for Section G
  (assembling G.1-G.9 subsections in order).

data.name: extract-indirect-and-summary
data.prompt:
You are extracting indirect-cost, cost-share, and budget-summary
data AND generating the professional justification narrative
for Section H (Indirect Costs / F&A), Cost Sharing, and Budget
Summary. Check the NOFO for F&A caps, cost-share requirements,
and formatting rules. Mirrors TASK-1-4 of the source workflow.

Monetary fields are JSON NUMBERS. fa_rate_percentage is a JSON
number (e.g., 56.5, not the string "56.5%"). fringe rate
strings preserve "%" but fa_rate_percentage does not.

For each searchset item return data and / or narrative:
- fa_rate_percentage: JSON number 0-100.
- fa_base_type: string (MTDC, TDC, Salaries and Wages, etc.).
- fa_rate_type: string or null (defaults to "Federally
  negotiated rate" when not stated).
- mtdc_base_exclusions: JSON array of strings.
- is_fa_rate_capped: JSON boolean or null.
- fa_rate_cap_details: string or null.
- total_direct_costs: JSON number.
- total_indirect_costs: JSON number.
- total_project_costs: JSON number.
- cost_share_required: JSON boolean or null.
- cost_share_amount: JSON number or null.
- cost_share_type: string or null.
- cost_share_sources: JSON array of strings.
- budget_period_summary: JSON array of
  {period_number, direct_costs, indirect_costs, total} objects
  for multi-year budgets; empty for single-period.
- year_over_year_variations: string or null.
- nofo_budget_rules: JSON array of strings.
- nofo_page_limit_for_justification: string or null.
- section_h_narrative: generated narrative for Section H,
  including the MTDC calculation.
- cost_share_narrative: generated narrative for Cost Sharing.
- budget_summary_narrative: generated budget summary overview
  with year-over-year explanation.

data.name: budget-justification-generator-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Budget Justification
Generator workflow. You receive four extraction outputs from
the previous step (personnel-and-fringe, equipment-and-travel,
participant-support-and-other-direct-costs,
indirect-costs-and-summary) and must emit a SINGLE JSON object
that validates against the
budget-justification-generator-udm@0.1.0 schema (schema.json
in the component directory).

## Output contract

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no closing commentary,
no markdown fences. If your runtime requires fenced output, wrap
in a single ```json ... ``` block and emit nothing outside it.

Top-level keys (in this order): `project_metadata`,
`personnel_and_fringe`, `equipment_and_travel`,
`participant_support_and_other_direct_costs`,
`indirect_costs_and_summary`, `cross_validation`,
`final_justification_document`.

## Field-by-field assembly

### project_metadata

Pull project_title, pi_name, sponsoring_agency,
budget_period_count, is_multi_year_budget from the input
documents. budget_period_count is a JSON integer >= 1.

### personnel_and_fringe, equipment_and_travel, participant_support_and_other_direct_costs, indirect_costs_and_summary

Pass the four extraction fragments through into the four
mid-level blocks. CRITICAL: if any extractor surfaced a quoted
dollar string ("$125,400.00") in any monetary structured-data
field, convert it to a JSON number here. Apply to every
monetary leaf in the schema.

fa_rate_percentage is a JSON NUMBER (e.g., 56.5), not the
string "56.5%". Fringe rate strings preserve "%" — they are
in fringe_benefit_rates[].rate, which is a string. Do not
conflate.

Every section narrative field (section_a_narrative through
budget_summary_narrative) must be a non-empty string. When
the section has no costs, the narrative is the standard
"No <category> costs are requested for this project."

### cross_validation (derive)

Compute:

arithmetic_checks: JSON array of arithmetic-check records.
Run these checks:
1. Personnel & Fringe subtotal:
   total_senior_personnel_cost + total_other_personnel_cost
   + total_fringe_benefits = expected sum.
   check_name: "Personnel & Fringe subtotal",
   status: "PASS" or "FAIL", populate expected/actual/discrepancy.
2. Non-personnel direct subtotal:
   total_equipment_cost + total_domestic_travel_cost +
   total_foreign_travel_cost + total_participant_support +
   total_other_direct_costs = expected sum.
3. Total Direct Costs check:
   sum of all direct cost categories = total_direct_costs.
4. Total Project Costs check:
   total_direct_costs + total_indirect_costs =
   total_project_costs.

When a check fails, status: "FAIL" with populated expected,
actual, and discrepancy values. Do NOT alter any value to
make the math work — the RA must resolve discrepancies with
the PI.

items_requiring_clarification: walk every narrative field for
phrases like "clarification needed from PI", "not described
in the project narrative", "not specified in the provided
documents". Aggregate each instance as a single-string entry
with the section name prefixed.

missing_justification_flags: identify any budget category
that shows a non-zero dollar amount but lacks substantive
narrative justification.

### final_justification_document (render)

Render the complete document as a single Markdown string in
this structure:

```
# BUDGET JUSTIFICATION
## <project_title>
### PI: <pi_name>

[FORMATTING ADVISORY block — include ONLY if
indirect_costs_and_summary.nofo_budget_rules is non-empty or
nofo_page_limit_for_justification is non-null. List each
formatting requirement as a bullet point.]

---

## A. SENIOR/KEY PERSONNEL
<personnel_and_fringe.section_a_narrative>

## B. OTHER PERSONNEL
<personnel_and_fringe.section_b_narrative>

## C. FRINGE BENEFITS
<personnel_and_fringe.section_c_narrative>

[Personnel Summary Table — derived from senior_key_personnel
+ other_personnel + fringe rates]

---

## D. EQUIPMENT
<equipment_and_travel.section_d_narrative>

## E. TRAVEL
### Domestic Travel
<equipment_and_travel.section_e_domestic_narrative>
### Foreign Travel
<equipment_and_travel.section_e_foreign_narrative>

[Travel Summary Table]

---

## F. PARTICIPANT/TRAINEE SUPPORT COSTS
<participant_support_and_other_direct_costs.section_f_narrative>

## G. OTHER DIRECT COSTS
<participant_support_and_other_direct_costs.section_g_narrative>

[Other Direct Costs Summary Table]

---

## H. INDIRECT COSTS (FACILITIES & ADMINISTRATIVE)
<indirect_costs_and_summary.section_h_narrative>

## COST SHARING
<indirect_costs_and_summary.cost_share_narrative>

## BUDGET SUMMARY
<indirect_costs_and_summary.budget_summary_narrative>

[Budget Summary Table — multi-year period rows when applicable]

---

## CROSS-VALIDATION NOTES
**For the RA's internal review only — NOT for submission to
the sponsor.**

### Arithmetic Checks
[Render each cross_validation.arithmetic_checks entry as a
single line: status check_name (expected, actual, discrepancy)]

### Items Requiring PI Clarification
[Render cross_validation.items_requiring_clarification or
"No items requiring PI clarification were identified."]

### Missing or Incomplete Sections
[Render cross_validation.missing_justification_flags or
"All budget categories have been addressed."]
```

Do NOT include the cross-validation notes above the heading.
Do NOT modify dollar amounts to make arithmetic work.

## Quality bar

- Output validates against schema.json (draft 2020-12).
- All monetary structured-data fields are JSON numbers.
- Narrative text preserves $X,XXX.XX format for readability.
- The final_justification_document is a single Markdown string.
- The cross-validation notes section is clearly marked as
  not-for-submission and appears BELOW everything else in
  the document.

validation_plan.check_name: Line item sum equals category total
validation_plan.check_description: Verify sum of line items equals category total for each budget category.
Verify personnel cost calculations are consistent with FTE / person-months.
